name: PhenoRegistry
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: The current default history contains a handbook absorption. New PhenoShared work integrates registry implementation crates while this repository remains listed and owned.
role: Curated identity, role and portfolio projections
concerns: Implementation crates moving does not automatically move accepted policy, source intent or all durable state.
A long squash message includes historical changes; do not count them all as fresh delivery.
